releases.name: Build Survivors
releases.summary: Drop onto a hostile planet, blast through endless hordes and grow absurdly powerful! Hunt down every boss, rip out its power core and make it back to your ship alive... or lose it all! Level up, unlock characters and stack crazy builds with no limits!

releases.name: Frogs Jump Together
releases.summary: Leap to new heights in Frogs Jump Together! Play solo or team up in online co-op where you control agile frogs navigating tricky obstacles. Jump on your friends' backs to reach secret shortcuts, master your leaps, and climb your way to the very top!

releases.name: Arbiter
releases.summary: A third-person fantasy action game where you wield powerful magic, liberate towns, and battle dangerous foes across a chain of islands.

releases.name: Demonator
releases.summary: TOP 25 Free Arcade Game in Germany, Italy, Spain, France, Luxembourg, Canada,Belgium!INTROImpudent and spiteful cheeses are attacking our planet. The united humanity called for Monster-Mouse to solve the problem. Monster-Mouse began it’s liberating mission. HOW TO PLAY:* Controlling the mouse (using the accelerometer), the player must eat all cheeses. You should avoid cats and fire. Use bombs to destroy enemiesFEATURES:* Addictive gameplay  * Awesome explosion effects* Dynamic soundtrack* Funny sounds* IPad 3 SupportHAVE FUN!

releases.name: STOREBOT: Tidy Up PC Parts
releases.summary: Organize thousands of PC parts, complete shelves, unlock powerful upgrades, and work together with friends to tidy up a chaotic computer store. Carry, throw, and sort boxes across two unique maps while building your perfect store.

releases.name: SLUP
releases.summary: Collect Gems, keep your combo alive, and outrun your own past. Every path you take returns as a moving Past, turning your previous choices into deadly obstacles in this strategic arcade score-attack game.

releases.name: Decisive Decks
releases.summary: Command a WWII fleet in DECISIVE DECKS, a turn-based naval deckbuilder. Choose from four nations, build your deck, and chart your course across the oceans. Read enemy intentions, combine gunfire, torpedoes, and air strikes, and use research to shape your strategy.

releases.name: Physics Exam Trainer
releases.summary: Physics Exam Trainer is a 3D interactive physics game. Observe an experiment, calculate what should happen, make your prediction, then run it and see whether reality agrees. Explore mechanics, circuits, optics and more through hands-on experiments built around Calculate → Predict → Run.

releases.name: GomokuSoccer
releases.summary: Place or Flick? In Gomoku Soccer, you can place your stones just to build a line of five, or flick them off the board and watch your opponent crashing out. Test your strategy and your aim!

releases.name: A Journey Through the Light
releases.summary: Wield a glowing blade through luminous forests, frozen ruins, and a fiery temple. Chain attacks, dash, and dodge in this 2D action adventure. Earn runes through trials, unlock new paths, and face the mighty Core Titan.

releases.name: NumeNume
releases.summary: Salvador is a fun and frolic archery game that tests your archery skills. It's just a great game to kick back on the couch and play.In this, the player is provided with a bow & arrow to cut the hangman's rope, without causing the victim a further hit.It gives you a chance to save the victim before they run out of breath.Try and gain the perfect score by saving the man as soon as possible, using least number of arrows.Are you willing to become a Salvador?  What are you waiting for then?FEATURES:* Sensitive and intuitive controls to rotate bow and arrow in all direction.* User friendly interface.* Excellent sound effects.* Various exciting levels.* Share your experience with your friends on facebookFollow us on Facebook : www.facebook.com/SalvadorTheSaviourCommunity

releases.name: Dreadline Express
releases.summary: Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard the last human train. Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.

releases.name: Tenebris Somnia
releases.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. 

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

releases.name: Beyond These Stars
releases.summary: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

releases.name: A Dungeon Is You
releases.summary:
Oh no, you got hit by a truck and died. Fortunately you have been reincarnated as a dungeon core! All you know is what's inside your dungeon domain.

All you want is to grow stronger and expand your dungeon.

A Dungeon Is You is a modern incremental management game.

releases.name: Murder&Spies
releases.summary: From the creator of hit mobile game "Spy.io" comes "Murder&Spies", a unique take on the multiplayer murder mystery genre. In this online social deduction game, every player is a spy with a single objective: eliminate your assigned target while staying hidden from the spy hunting you.

releases.name: Night Blood W : Cutthroat Wolf
releases.summary: Nightblood W: Cutthroat Wolf is a cyberpunk 2D pixel action game. Customize your own build, zip through neon skyscrapers with your grappling, unleash lethal combos, immerse yourself in lightning-fast combat, and feel the ultimate adrenaline rush!

releases.name: Season Island
releases.summary: A point & click visual novel where every season has a story to tell.

releases.name: Terradune
releases.summary: Terradune is a hand-drawn, top-down 2D action RPG where ability Augments reshape your build. Turn attacks into traps, debuffs, burst damage, or defensive tools as you explore dangerous regions, conquer dungeons, collect loot, and defeat bosses in real-time combat.

releases.name: Flipping is Hard
releases.summary: No Legs. Just Flips. A hard and punishing game where you flip, fall, and climb as Flippy, using only rotation. Do you have what it takes to get back to Jeff?

releases.name: The King's Gambit
releases.summary: Take part in a feast as an undercover assassin! Your goal is to kill the enemy king and secure the throne for your ruler. But watch out! There are enemy assassins who would like to eliminate you and your king. Blend into the crowd and find a way to reach your goal!

releases.name: Penguin Colony
releases.summary:
A faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft through the eyes of a penguin. Developed by Origame Digital, creators of Umurangi Generation, published by Fellow Traveller (1000xRESIST), and narrated by Lenval Brown.

The year is 1939, and two rival groups are making their way into the deep Antarctic to answer the call of an impossibly ancient being. One seeks to extract this inconceivable power for its own destructive means. The other, as it has been doing for generations, hopes to return it to its slumber for another hundred years.

These humans, with their strange sights and sounds, will pique the curiosity of the local penguins. Embody any one of these penguins and wander the frozen landscape, following the humans in their discoveries, and witnessing their minds collapse under the strain.

releases.name: Ducking Grenades
releases.summary: Make lots of things go BOOM in this fast-paced 2D side-scrolling action game! Do you like explosions? Everything explodes. Hunt down the Evil General Goosey and his minions and bring peace to the universe!
